Based on the provided abstract, the study specifically synthesizes a polyacrylamide-titanium dioxide ($\text{PAA@TiO}_2$) nanocomposite via a cross-linking method (using N,N′-methylenebisacrylamide) to remove crystal violet (CV) dye from water, finding a maximum adsorption capacity of approximately $38.9\text{ mg g}^{-1}$ and elucidating the molecular-level interactions via Monte Carlo and molecular dynamics simulations. 

This directly aligns with and supports Hypothesis 2.

CHOICE: 2
